ValidationRule.description: VAT Number or Registration ID or Other Fiscal ID is Mandatory for Lead Conversion
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), NOT( ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , 'Webform') ), ER_Business_Unit__c != 'BE', AND( IsConverted =true, ISBLANK(ER_VAT_Number__c), ISBLANK( ER_Registration_Number__c), ISBLANK( ER_Other_Fiscal_ID__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Filling VAT Number or Company Registration Number or Other Fiscal ID is mandatory for conversion
